Institutional Tariff Governance & Price Transparency Standard CEA Sec 5 & NABH-SHCO 4.2

Tariff Architecture Rule: Master tariffs establish standard published fees with strict effective-date auditing. Visit-specific concessions, discounts, or waivers MUST NOT overwrite master tariff definitions; concessions are granted exclusively as authorized, auditable transaction-level adjustments linked to approving authority credentials.
